verdict.rationale: Gitea's first-party docs say it tracks requirements, features, and bugs as issues. They also document labels and assignments on those issues, which covers every element of the story. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of label and assignee management beyond brief overview statements, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the issue tracker.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bugs, features, and requirements as issues with labels and assignees

citations.quote: Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues.
Efficiently manage requirements, features, and bugs through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards.
Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.
